topics.title: Site safety, tools and setting out
topics.objective: Apply safe site practice, select tools and establish accurate building lines and levels.

topics.title: Building materials and testing

questions.prompt: What is the first control required before workers enter an unsupported excavation?

options.label: A
options.text: Provide an appropriate protective system and safe access
options.rationale: This is the supported answer. Excavation sides can collapse without warning, so shoring, shielding or safe battering must be selected for the ground conditions and accompanied by secure access.

options.label: B
options.text: Stack excavated soil at the trench edge
options.rationale: This is a credible same-domain alternative, but it does not satisfy the principle or condition tested in this item.

options.label: C
options.text: Rely on the soil standing for the duration of the work
options.rationale: This is a credible same-domain alternative, but it does not satisfy the principle or condition tested in this item.

options.label: D
options.text: Send one worker ahead to test the sides by hand
options.rationale: This is a credible same-domain alternative, but it does not satisfy the principle or condition tested in this item.

questions.workedSolution: Excavation sides can collapse without warning, so shoring, shielding or safe battering must be selected for the ground conditions and accompanied by secure access. Therefore the correct answer is A: Provide an appropriate protective system and safe access.
